summary: Delete repository secret AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY_CONTENT (class c, credentials; RFC-0061 phase 3)

options.description: Operator deletes the AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY_CONTENT repository secret once the PR for AISDLC-1173 has merged (the clean-room job no longer reads it)
Keep the secret for now; revisit after the MCP tarball signing key is reviewed

body:
taskId: AISDLC-1173
sourceWorktree: /Users/dominique/Documents/dev/ai-sdlc/ai-sdlc/.worktrees/aisdlc-1173

AISDLC-1173 removes the key materialization step from untrusted-pr-gate.yml, so nothing in the repository reads AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY_CONTENT any more. Deleting a repository secret needs the operator's identity and credentials (class c); this task does not attempt it. AISDLC_SIGNING_KEY (release.yml, MCP tarball signing) is a different secret and is untouched.
